headline: Browser and workflow tools automate plant genome, synteny, and transcriptome analysis
label: Omics Data Analysis Software
summary: Preprints now package plant gene family, synteny, and RNA-seq analyses into installation-free or containerized tools for routine use.
synthesis: The dominant thread is delivery of plant genomics analyses as packaged, reusable tools that reduce assembly and installation barriers. PhytoFam is a Nextflow pipeline that identifies gene families from proteomes using HMMER, InterProScan, RBH orthology, and IQ-TREE3 phylogenetics. SyntenyPair Explorer is a single-file, installation-free browser tool for interactive pairwise synteny visualization from FASTA, GFF3/GTF, BLAST outfmt 6, or MCScanX inputs. VizR is a Docker-deployable web platform that unifies automated RNA-seq processing, interactive expression visualization, and GO analysis for plant transcriptomics. What is new across these items is end-to-end integration within a single tool, with VizR spanning processing through GO analysis and PhytoFam chaining homology search, orthology, and phylogeny. The three items address distinct analytical domains, so the shared element is packaging rather than a common algorithm.
